title: contrib.funsor.infer.TraceEnum_ELBO can compute inaccurate elbo for certain guide-enumerated models
author: ordabayevy

comments.author: eb8680
comments.body:
Good catch!  I'm not opposed to adding a temporary fix to `TraceMarkovEnum_ELBO` like the one you suggested, since it would unblock your problem, but it would be nice to at least find a way to avoid exponentiation of individual terms and the accompanying numerical underflows.

As a reference, there's a [correct, numerically stable, optimized version of this computation in Pyro](https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/blob/dev/pyro/infer/util.py#L249), although the implementation is quite complicated and I think we could do better than just porting it directly.

comments.author: ordabayevy
comments.body: @eb8680 the newly added `sum_product.compute_expectation` is the stripped down version of the function mention [here](https://github.com/pyro-ppl/pyro/pull/2716#issuecomment-750772256). If it works we can later update it to compute expectation wrt to markov variables too.
